mechanism.summary: EsaI supplies 3OC6HSL, while apo-EsaR binds DNA and supports two distinct architectures: repression at PesaR and activation at PesaS; AHL binding releases EsaR from DNA and reverses those effects.
steps: EsaI synthesizes the AHL signal used by the native EsaI/EsaR quorum-sensing system.
Without 3OC6HSL, EsaR represses PesaR, so adding signal produces derepression and increased output.
Without 3OC6HSL, EsaR activates PesaS, so adding signal removes activation and decreases output.
